metadata.description: Stage 3 Security Testing — P²IM pass 1 (related work, run directly): rebuild each firmware as an ELF under parsed_elfs/<id>.elf from firmxray_results.base_address. Kept separate from the fuzzing pass because ConvertFirmToELF unpacks its ELFBuilder helper to a fixed /tmp path, so it is not concurrency-safe — hence threads: 1, as in the reference's config_gen_elf_for_firmxray.json — and because the fuzzing pass imports elf_path, which only exists once this pass has run. Table: convert_elf_results.
metadata.constraint: WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM firmxray_results WHERE base_address IS NOT NULL)
